As you guys can see , there is a red mark on my dogs FACE. He has been CUT THREE TIMES AS YOU GUYS CAN SEE . I would give this place 0 stars if I could . Me and my mother dropped my dog off at 10 am and never got a call back . We decided to walk back inside to see what he’s doing and they did not start anything yet ! He has basically been inside this place as IF it was a SCHOOL. This is horrible place. If your dog was ever hurt like this you would’ve been pee’d off also. My dog has been having aloe of irritations like licking his paw and now he is always laying down looking sad and he’s very hyper and fun most of the time. As we were sitting down we saw another dog that a man was cutting and he cut the coat off to the point you could see the girl dogs pink SKIN. Me personally I was really trying to take my dog away because it’s very irritable to not have anything done to your dog after being there for about 8 hours. The lady really just wanted her money and honestly I would’ve kept him how he was before. I’m now on learning my lesson on not to try any new people to cut my dogs hair. ONLY THE ORIGINAL. Poor baby . PLEASE READ REVIEWS BEFORE YOU TRY THE SALON. They possibly could’ve had my dog 10AM— 10PM . TRACK YOURE TIME DOG E- STYLEZ!!!
I drove by one day and I saw that they were mistreating the dogs when they wouldn’t stay still.

Very disappointed. They cut my dog, and did not tell us. When we called the guy claimed she had “warts” that likely got nicked when he shaved her head” I check my dog over pretty much everyday, so I would know if she did have warts.

A dog groomer has the responsibility to tell the owner immediately about an incident or if they cut the dog, regardless of an accident or not. It broke my heart to see my dog’s cut and think about her possibly yelping/crying out in pain.

I’m very disappointed.
